note: Rejudged after keepaliveLoop (network_phase.go) and negotiatePhases (phases.go) gained unsupported-protocol LCP Protocol-Reject dispatch (RFC 1661 Section 5.7) and the no-NCP idle-period timer (RFC 1661 Section 3.7). Re-read RFC 1661 Section 4.3's Implementation Note under RCR+/RCR- ('These events may occur on a connection which is already in the Opened state. The implementation MUST be prepared to immediately renegotiate the Configuration Options.'). In keepaliveLoop, clientSupportsProtocol always admits ProtoLCP, so a received LCP Configure-Request still reaches requestLCPReentry and reenter(reentry); reenter cancels any armed no-NCP idle timer before invoking connectedSession.restart, and a *lcpReentry returned from handleIPCP still routes into reenter. In negotiatePhases, runIPCP now receives ipcpRun{ipv6, lcpIdentifier} so Protocol-Rejects share the LCP Identifier sequence, while an LCP Configure-Request during Auth or IPCP still returns *lcpReentry and immediately restarts the epoch loop with scr before sca/scn. All six tagged test units are byte-identical: the server tests require exact tld/scr/sca or tld/scr/scn actions, Ack-Sent, Configure-Request and Ack output and no session-down; the Echo control refuses scr/tld; the client Auth, IPCP and Network probes require own Configure-Request directly before exact peer Ack with Identifier 0x73 and Magic-Number 0x55667788.
